subject: Vendor enablement intake — alignment call & MAP prep
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enablement intake — alignment call & MAP prep

Hi Elena,

Welcome — excited to get CloudMetrics into our vendor intake flow. I'd like to schedule a 45-minute intake session to align on the mutual action plan (MAP), PO process, and the vendor onboarding checklist so we can move toward a Dedicated capacity pilot. Proposed slots (PDT):

- Mon Jun 5, 10:00–10:45
- Tue Jun 6, 13:00–13:45
- Wed Jun 7, 09:00–09:45

Agenda I suggest:
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Procurement touchpoints & primary contact (10m)
3) MAP walkthrough — milestones, owner handoffs (15m)
4) PO timing, invoicing & contract redlines (10m)
5) Open items & next steps (5m)

Please confirm which slot works or share alternatives. Also include the person on your side who handles POs / vendor enrollment and confirm whether CloudMetrics requires a specific W-9 / tax form or vendor portal details.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist and a draft MAP for review before the call (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_draft.docx).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB); mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (docx, 28KB)

From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@cloudmetrics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jun 2028 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement intake — alignment call & MAP prep

Hi Irene — thanks for reaching out and for the materials. Happy to align. Our procurement lead is on copy for PO logistics: procure_ops@cloudmetrics.com (I cc'ed them here). For availability, Tue Jun 6 at 13:00 PDT works best for our team.

Quick notes:
- We typically require a standard Master Services Agreement (we can share our redlines) and a vendor onboarding packet (we'll send the tax forms).
- Our PO window after signature is typically 7–10 business days; if a sandbox is needed earlier we can discuss temporary access.

Adding procurement contact now. See forwarded note.

Best,
Elena Vargas
Head of Partnerships | CloudMetrics
elena.vargas@cloudmetrics.com

Date: Tue, 6 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enablement intake — alignment call & MAP prep

Thanks Elena — Tue 2028-06-06 13:00 PDT is confirmed. Calendar invite to follow.

Pre-call prep / asks from Redwood:
- Procurement: please bring W-9 and preferred invoicing fields (billing address, remit-to, PO references).
- CloudMetrics: if you have a set of standard contract redlines, please share them beforehand so our legal can triage.
- Internal: Laura (CS onboarding lead) and Markus (billing/finance) will join to cover success criteria and invoicing cadence.

Updated agenda (45m):
1) Intros & success criteria (5m) — Laura
2) MAP overview + milestone owners (15m) — Irene
3) PO/invoice timing, banking fields (10m) — Markus
4) Technical sandbox access & timeline (10m) — Laura
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

I've uploaded the MAP draft and checklist to the shared link: https://redwood.app/shared/MAP/RDW-4821 — please add comments. Also attaching the checklist again for quick reference.

Action items (pre-call):
- CloudMetrics: share any contract redlines and the W-9 to procure_ops@cloudmetrics.com and me.
- Redwood Internal: review MAP draft and flag any missing milestones by EOD Mon Jun 12.

Look forward to the call.

—
Irene Choi
Head of Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB); mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (docx, 28KB)

Thanks — added the following internal stakeholders to the MAP comments:
- Laura Bennett (CS onboarding lead) — success criteria, sandbox validation, and training schedule.
- Markus Klein (Finance) — invoicing cadence, PO acceptance, and payment terms.
- Product Ops (TBD) — will join if there are special routing or regional deployment requirements.

I reviewed the checklist and suggested a new milestone for "Security questionnaire delivery" (due before sandbox access). Please confirm if CloudMetrics can complete the vendor security questionnaire within 3 business days after the intake call.

See you on Tue.
